title: Kendrick Lamar's birth chart
metaDescription: Kendrick Lamar's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.1° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the ten placements whose signs are settled fall in mutable signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. The mutable signs hand one season to the next; a chart weighted there is built for transitions.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 26.1° Gemini — the third decan, 20°–30°, which the tradition sub-rules by Saturn. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Gemini and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 16.4° Cancer; Venus stands at 8.0° Gemini; Mars stands at 17.9° Cancer. The tradition reads a mind that absorbs before it argues from Mercury, taste led by wit and proportion from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Neptune sextile Pluto, 0.5° of separation. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Jupiter trine Uranus at 0.8°, and the Sun opposition Uranus at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, one sits in a sign it has an opinion about. Mars in Cancer at 17.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 water, 3 fire, 2 air, 1 earth by element and 5 mutable, 4 cardinal, 1 fixed by mode. Water reads the room before the room speaks — atmosphere first, analysis later. Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.8° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 17.6°.
